summary: A playable isometric action-RPG slice: two classes, a seeded wilderness, a three-floor crypt, two multi-phase bosses, affix loot with identify/salvage/reroll/sockets, quests, Normal/Veteran, Target Hunt and checksummed IndexedDB saves, all procedural and tested end to end.
notes: Verified only through headless software-rendered Chrome, scripted input and bots; real-GPU frame rate, audio by ear and a hand-played full session were not verified. Stack deviates from the brief (three.js, vanilla DOM, grid collision) - see ONESHOT-REPORT.md. Dev helper URL params: ?autostart=cinder|ranger and &bench=1. Restarted from an empty workspace after the first attempt died on a provider error. This build is from the second, uninterrupted run.
